lines.zh: 两条后腿踩着地，一步一顿。
lines.en: Two legs, one heavy step after another.

lines.zh: 我这五米高的身板，走得慢。
lines.en: Five blocks tall means I walk slowly.
My tail sweeps a swath through the grass.
These little arms are useless for walking.

lines.zh: 爪尖陷进土里，又拔出来。
lines.en: My claws sink into soil and pull free.
The ground answers every step.
I follow the wind for a scent.
The treetops reach only my shoulder.
I duck under a branch.
My foot is bigger than a man's head.
The savanna is wide enough to turn around in.
Step by step I head toward water.

lines.zh: 我站着，喉咙里滚着低音。
lines.en: I stand with a low rumble in my throat.
The sun bakes my spine.
The wind passes and I blink.
I scrape my jaw with a claw.
No enemies in this stretch.
I open my mouth and let out a breath.
My tail sways slowly side to side.
I taste blood on the air.

lines.zh: 影子把我脚下的草都遮了。
lines.en: My shadow covers the grass under me.
I wait for something to move.
This patch is warm; I rest a while.
A tooth nicks my tongue.

lines.zh: 又一声长啸从远处传来。
lines.en: Another long cry drifts from far away.
I answer with a low growl.
You barely reach my knee.
I have to lower my head to see you.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像石头，不像草原。
lines.en: You smell of stone, not savanna.
I tilt my head and sniff your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔在你头顶张开。
lines.en: My nostrils flare above your head.

lines.zh: 我这体型一站就挡住太阳。
lines.en: Standing, I blot out the sun.
I can see your heartbeat.
You are too small to be worth a meal.
The moment your heel turns, I know.
I tilt my head a little.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里是块会走的肉。
lines.en: To me you are a cut of meat that walks.

lines.zh: 我舔了下牙，你最好别动。
lines.en: I run my tongue over my teeth; best you keep still.

lines.zh: 我的吼声把鸟群都惊飞了。
lines.en: My roar scatters the birds.

lines.zh: 皮太厚，可这一下还是疼。
lines.en: My hide is thick, and that still hurt.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，血落在地上。
lines.en: I shake my head; blood falls to the ground.

lines.zh: 厚皮上多了道口子，无妨。
lines.en: A gash in my thick hide; no matter.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，尾巴扫倒一棵树。
lines.en: I give half a step and my tail fells a tree.

lines.zh: 我甩尾打断了一棵小树。
lines.en: My tail whips through a small tree.
My breathing sounds like a bellows.
The wound is on my ribs; I turn my flank.
My blood runs hot.
I do not run.
Meat; this I recognize.
That would not fill a gap in my teeth.
Toss it here; do not hold it up.
Let me sniff it before I eat.
Raw is better.
You are feeding me?
That smell reminds me of prey.

lines.zh: 生肉的血味，我闻得最清。
lines.en: The blood-scent of raw meat is clearest to me.
Put it down and back off three steps.
After that I may only be hungrier.
You hit my leg.
One step of mine sends you far.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾比你的头还大。
lines.en: My toe is bigger than your head.
My toe touched you.

lines.zh: 这点重量，我没什么感觉。
lines.en: That much weight means nothing to me.
Shift to the side.
Did my tail catch you?
I look down and you are still there.

lines.zh: 你比我身上一只跳蚤还小。
lines.en: You are smaller than a flea on me.
I stop and wait for you to clear out.
This season I think only of eating.
My kind are few and the calls are far.
Do you hear that answer from the distance?
My tail is not built for such talk.
That is not my plan now.
Let me grow big enough first.

lines.zh: 我连自己的地盘都守不住。
lines.en: I cannot even hold my own ground.
Why do you ask this?
Let the wind bring the scent.

lines.zh: 这些事对我来说太远了。
lines.en: Such things are far beyond me.
Meat on the ground; I take it.

lines.zh: 这东西在我爪子里很小。
lines.en: It looks tiny in my claws.
I snatch it up and move on.
Even mud-caked, I will have it.

lines.zh: 我低下长脖子，一口叼走。
lines.en: I lower my long neck and snatch it up.
This much will not line my stomach.
Did you drop it? I have it now.
Is it food? I bite it first.
Carrying it while walking is awkward.
I bury it in the soil for later.
You moved; so it is you.
My head comes up all at once.
The smell comes from your direction.

lines.zh: 一看到会跑的，我就要追。
lines.en: When something can run, I must chase it.
You stand directly in front of me.
My roar flattens the grass first.
My claws dig into the ground.
You are late to start running.
Only you can move in this stretch.
Anything that moves gets a bite.
Smelling of sweat like that, you won't run far.
This leg moves before you do.
Five blocks tall, one pounce reaches you.
The target is you.
I circle toward your side.
You are hiding behind a tree.
That tree will not stop me.
I lower my head to find your scent.
Your footprints still press the grass.

lines.zh: 灌木被我的尾巴压平了。
lines.en: The shrubs flatten under my tail.
You retreat slower than I walk.
There is no cover on this savanna.

lines.zh: 草在我脚下被压成一条道。
lines.en: The grass flattens into a path under me.
You changed direction.
So did I.

lines.zh: 我把重心压低，后腿蹬紧。
lines.en: I drop my weight and tense my hind legs.
You hear that sound, do you not.
I am holding my patience.
Once I am close, the chase ends.
I stoop and bite down.
One stomping foot sinks the ground.
My tail sweeps across your flank.
A snap of the head and the teeth arrive.
This bite goes through bone.
You are knocked flying.
I press down with both feet.
My jaw slams your shoulder.

lines.zh: 草原这么大，我扑得很准。
lines.en: The savanna is wide, and my pounce is accurate.
I bite and do not let go.
You are small; one bite is enough.
I shove you backward.
My teeth snap shut beside your ear.
That kick sends grass flying.

lines.zh: 我从草原的另一头走出来。
lines.en: I walk in from the far end of the savanna.
A tree fell; I brushed it.

lines.zh: 这里的地够结实，能承住我。
lines.en: This ground is firm enough to hold me.
A long roar carries far ahead of me.
I smell something new.
The grass reaches my knees.
The sun is at my back.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，看了看四周。
lines.en: I lower my head and look around.
This stretch is still empty; good.

lines.zh: 我的脚把石头踩成了粉。
lines.en: My foot grinds a stone to powder.
Something is running nearby.

lines.zh: 这条路上没有比我大的。
lines.en: Nothing on this road is bigger than me.

lines.zh: 我踩碎石头，从山坡下来。
lines.en: Crushing stone, I come down the slope.
But I am hungry.
I plant my feet and wait for the first sound.

lines.zh: 这一片草原，从今天起归我。
lines.en: This savanna belongs to me from today.

lines.zh: 火在鳞片间烧，我抖了抖身。
lines.en: Fire burns between my scales; I shake myself.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，撞断几棵树。
lines.en: I slide down the slope, snapping trees.

lines.zh: 水盖过头顶，我蹬着往上游。
lines.en: Water closes over me; I kick upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀开了一层土，我被推歪。
lines.en: The blast tears up soil and shoves me aside.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎进我的肩。
lines.en: Something sharp buries in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 光落在我背上，皮在发麻。
lines.en: Light falls on my back and my hide goes numb.
Hunger makes my legs feel thin.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and I lock up.

lines.zh: 脚下的地没了，我直直往下掉。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I drop straight down.
